desc: Analyze the problem constraints and properties of alternating permutations.
Determine that a digit-by-digit construction with combinatorial counting is required due to $n \le 100$.
Formulate the algorithm: iterate positions, try candidates in sorted order, calculate valid completions using factorials of remaining odd/even counts.
Implement the solution with the digit-by-digit construction approach.
Precompute factorials, capping at $10^{15} + 1$ to prevent unnecessary large number arithmetic.
For each position, determine the parity constraint.
For each candidate, calculate the number of valid completions.
Adjust $k$ and select the appropriate candidate.
Return empty list if $k$ is out of range.
